subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The Invention of the Drum Roaster
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Invention of the Drum Roaster.

hook.text: The first commercial drum roaster was patented in 1849 by James Carter in Boston. It mechanized an ancient craft.

buildup.text: A rotating metal cylinder over a gas flame tumbled beans evenly. For the first time, large batches could roast uniformly.

discovery.text: Drum roasting made commercial coffee possible. Before it, each household or shop roasted its own small batches.

twist.text: German company Probat, founded in 1868, became the dominant manufacturer. Many vintage Probats still run today.

climax.text: The drum roaster turned coffee from a cottage craft into a global industry. It's still the most common roasting technology.

punchline.text: A spinning drum, even heat, massive scale. One machine built an industry.

quiz.question: Who patented the first commercial drum coffee roaster?
